positions.title: Security Sales Engineer
positions.description:
Assist the sales team as a technical resource to provide our customers with the best solutions to meet their physical security needs. Collaborate with customers both over the phone and at the customers’ sites to assess options for their security systems. Consult with vendors concerning how to meet customers’ needs with their respective systems and to provide per job pricing. Work with our Operations team to provide successful installations.

•	Estimated over 930 bids totaling more than $31M in the last four years.
•	Maintained and Updated the bidding worksheet to make it more robust and to provide new features utilizing Excel Functions, Macros and VBA.
•	Received two Gold Star nominations for Ownership and Expertise.

positions.title: Night Merchandiser / Member Service Associate
positions.description:
Contributed to the club's bottom line by up-selling memberships and convincing members to sign up for store credit cards. Provided excellent customer service in handling product returns, new member sign-ups and filling customer orders.  Stocked and zoned most parts of the club. Trained to use the forklift and became a regular forklift driver. Learned to do receiving and participated in club wide inventory.

•	Received two awards for excellent customer service.
•	Trained and mentored five individuals in how to stock various parts of the club.
•	Trained and mentored two individuals to be receivers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Participated in the development and sustainment of the middleware layer of the customer records and billing system written in Java and Flow running on Linux platforms, utilizing WebMethods and Weblogic with Oracle DBMS. The system employed thin Java clients utilizing JSPs, Servlets, JMS, and web services connecting to back end databases through JDBC.

•	Primarily engaged with a user tool responsible for transferring customers between DISH and partner billing that interfaced with a third party billing system.
•	Authored project proposals for system enhancements. 
•	Managed a report generating batch application that was required to run daily.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to the development and sustainment of several large, distributed data processing and retrieval systems written in Java and C++ running on Solaris and Linux platforms, utilizing Weblogic with Sybase and Oracle DBMS. Systems employed both thick and thin Java clients utilizing JSPs, Servlets, EJBs, JMS, and web services connecting to back end databases through JDBC.

•	Engineered design changes that resulted in a 75% reduction in the installation of the system.  
•	Participated in a special working group tasked with the discovery, evaluation, and remediation of installation issues. 
•	Facilitated the conversion of applications running on a Solaris/Sybase platform to run on a Linux/Oracle platform.
•	Aided user training in both one-on-one and class sessions. 
•	Primary software contact and troubleshooter for the tuning and configuration management groups.  
•	Worked closely with signals analysts to improve application quality and usability.
•	Wrote test plans and operator instruction sheets.
•	Determined specifications and researched prices for the procurement of hardware.
